column3: New reference view "stadium_night": the ravine ballpark during a night game, 21:00 clear, from the upper plaza / lot looking into the bowl and the floodlit field with the city glow beyond. Add ONE row to tools/refcams/cameras_w6.json, judge against a 2026 AAA game, fix the worst 3-5 things.

This is what the player sees walking up to a car. Add the row (with any staging needed) to tools/refcams/cameras_w6.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things on the cars themselves.

Add the row (with staging) to tools/refcams/cameras_w6.json, judge against a 2026 AAA crowd close-up, fix the worst 3-5 things on the person.

New reference view "pier_day": the amusement pier at 15:00 clear from the deck among the crowd, the wheel, rides, stands, the ocean. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w6.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

Palm crowns flicker, dither and show dark blocky holes (visible in the rain_day and suburb refcams on opengl3, and flagged unresolved by specular-aliasing). Find the cause in foliage.gdshader / the palm LOD ladder / TreesCloseup / TreeLight and fix it so palms read as solid, softly lit crowns at every distance on both renderers. Prove with strips of a slow pan.
